name: systemscope
description: Personal computer and network intelligence dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @systemscope/server" "npm run dev -w @systemscope/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @systemscope/server && npm run build -w @systemscope/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @systemscope/server && npm run typecheck -w @systemscope/client
